title: The Unburied
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.The Barthrones buried their dead in Wraithhollow until the dead stopped staying down. Morvaine the Pale carries the family's grave token, and Wilson Barthrone wants it back.

About

Given byWilson Barthrone
Level35
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Barthrone Grave Token ×1
  • Crypt Grave Token ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Wilson Barthrone (outdoors near Agauton) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 15 wraiths (15)
    Kill 2 banshees (2)
  3. Kill Morvaine the Pale inside Wraithhollow
    Bring Wilson Barthrone his family's grave token - Barthrone Grave Token at 1141, 194
    Bring Wilson Barthrone 3 crypt grave tokens (3) - Crypt Grave Token at 1141, 194
  4. Give Wilson Barthrone your answer at 1143, 194
  5. Talk to Layla Barthrone at 1198, 240

Rewards

Reward
Quest points1

What Wilson Barthrone says

Wilson Barthrone: That's ours. A pick over a hill. My great-grandmother pressed that mark with her own thumb.

Wilson Barthrone: These other three I don't know. I'll ask around town. Somebody's grandmother will know the marks.

Wilson Barthrone: Now, ours. Layla says it goes back in the ground, in the family plot behind the house. Egle says the ground lost it once already, and it should hang in the house where we can all see it.

Wilson Barthrone: They've argued about it since the day you went down. You carried it up, so you choose. Where does it belong?

You: The token goes in the ground, with the family.

Layla Barthrone: Then it goes beside my grandfather's stone. I'll dig the hole myself. He'd want it near him.

Layla Barthrone: Wilson will say a few words over it. He always says too many.

Layla Barthrone: Wilson left your pay with me. There's gold coming out of the drift now, so he was generous for once.

Handing it in

"Wilson left your pay with me. There's gold coming out of the drift now, so he was generous for once."
